description: Per-track color + thickness + visibility controls in the Paths tab, persisted as node properties, wired into render_gpx_tracks (currently hardcoded cyan LineStrip) via a TrackStyleMap and the existing fe-terrain track_mesh(width, ColorMode) ribbon path
wave_rationale: Builds the deferred FR-10 (per-track line styling) flagged in node_manager/AGENTS.md. Spans fe-ui (Paths-tab controls) + fe-terrain (render_gpx_tracks + TrackStyle) + fractalengine (populate style map from node props). Independent of the other two but shares path_editor_card.rs, so batch sequentially.
notes: User: 'control track color thickness and visibility'. Decision: per-track, in the Paths tab, persisted as node props (gis.track.color/width/visible). render_gpx_tracks hardcodes srgb(0,0.8,1) + LineStrip (1px, no width). Thickness needs switching to the ribbon track_mesh (mesh/track.rs:27). Add TrackStyle{color,width,visible} + TrackStyleMap in fe-terrain (next to TrackRouteMap in iot/animation.rs), populated by the gpx bridge from NodePropertiesLoaded. SetNodeProperty persist path is NOT quarantined.
